name: tree-sitter-umlay
description: tree-sitter grammar for the Umlay DSL. Powers GitHub syntax highlighting and editors that use tree-sitter (Neovim, Zed, Helix).

scripts.build: echo 'tree-sitter-umlay: skipping generate/node-gyp in workspace build — run `pnpm run build:grammar` when distributing'
scripts.build:grammar: tree-sitter generate && node-gyp configure && node-gyp build
